# Additions to Esther Chapter 5 (Addition E) — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther E | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_005_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition E: The royal counter-decree authorizing the Jews to fight back — and revealing that Haman was a Macedonian agent all along.]*

**1** This is a copy of the letter: "The Great King Artaxerxes sends greetings to the governors of the hundred and twenty-seven provinces from India to Ethiopia, and to all who are loyal to our government.

**2** Many men who have been loaded with honors by the generosity of their benefactors have become arrogant. Not content with oppressing those who live under our rule, they have turned around and plotted against the very people who showed them kindness.

**3** They have not only driven gratitude out of the human race entirely; they have puffed themselves up on the empty boasts of those who know nothing about goodness, and they imagine they can somehow slip past the ever-watchful eye of God — God, who hates evil.

**4** Time and again, those in positions of power have been duped into shedding innocent blood — talked into it by friends they trusted — and have found themselves caught in disasters they could not undo, all because of someone else's malicious deception.

**5** You do not have to look at ancient stories to see this. You can see it in what has happened wickedly in recent times, right before your eyes.

**6** We must therefore do better in the future and ensure our kingdom remains peaceful and undisturbed for all people,

**7** by making the necessary changes, and by making sure we evaluate everything that comes before us with fairer judgment.

**8** Haman son of Hammedatha — a Macedonian, alien to Persian blood, with no claim on our goodwill — was received as a guest and given access to the full measure of our generosity toward every nation. We treated him as a father. We gave him second rank after the throne. All people honored him.

**9** And he could not contain his arrogance. He plotted to destroy both us and our kingdom.

**10** Through lies and schemes he worked to bring about the death of Mordecai — the man who saved our life, the man who has never stopped benefiting us — and of Esther, the blameless queen who is partner in our kingdom. He wanted to wipe out their entire people.

**11** He believed that by destroying our allies he could transfer power from the Persians to the Macedonians.

**12** But we have looked into this and found that the Jews are not criminals. They live under the most just laws.

**13** They are sons of the Most High God — the great, living God — who has directed our kingdom and our ancestors' kingdom with complete excellence.

**14** Do not carry out the orders Haman son of Hammedatha sent you.

**15** He has already received what he deserved: he has been hanged at the gates of Susa, along with his entire household. God, who rules over everything, acted swiftly.

**16** Post this letter everywhere. Make it public.

**17** Let the Jews live by their own customs. Give them your support. On that day — the thirteenth of the twelfth month, Adar — let them defend themselves against whoever attacks them.

**18** The God who rules all things has turned that very day from a day of destruction for the chosen people into a day of joy.

**19** Include this day among your great festivals. Celebrate it with full joy.

**20** Let it be, from now on and forever, a day of rescue for us and for all who are loyal to the Persians — and a day that those who plot against us will never forget.

**21** Any city or country that fails to comply with these orders will be burned to the ground in fire and fury — made uninhabitable not only for human beings but loathsome even to wild animals and birds, for all time."
